title: Viet Template Benchmark Manifest & Comparative Methodology Specification
description: Authoritative registry of internal and comparative benchmark workloads, execution tracks, fairness constraints, and marketing claim eligibility rules.

participatingEngines.name: Quarkus Qute
participatingEngines.mode: Type-Safe Value Resolver / Compiled Section Helpers

TRACK_A_DYNAMIC.name: Dynamic & Interpreted Execution Track
TRACK_A_DYNAMIC.description: Engines executing untyped or dynamic lexical scopes via runtime interpretation, dynamic property resolution, or AST evaluation.

TRACK_B_COMPILED.name: Compiled & Bytecode Execution Track
TRACK_B_COMPILED.description: Engines executing precompiled JVM bytecode, ahead-of-time generated classes, or direct-dispatch accessor paths.

escapingSemantics.description: Workloads C01–C07 and B01–B07 evaluate unescaped raw throughput. Workloads C08 and B08 evaluate contextual HTML escaping. Cross-engine comparisons must compare raw with raw and escaped with escaped; unescaped templates must never be compared against auto-escaping configurations without explicit normalization.

warmedTemplateCaching.description: All templates across all engines must be parsed, compiled, and resolved into cache during JMH @Setup(Level.Trial). Zero template file I/O, on-demand compilation, or classloading overhead is permitted inside steady-state benchmark measurement loops.

sinkSemantics.description: All engines must materialize rendered content into standard in-memory buffers (String or byte output) consumed uniformly via JMH Blackhole to prevent dead-code elimination, compiler dead-loop elision, and uneven network/socket flushing bias.

runtimeEnvironment.description: All benchmark runs must enforce identical JVM flags (-server -Xms2g -Xmx2g -XX:+AlwaysPreTouch -XX:+UseG1GC) and consume identical data model instances across all comparative adapters.

workloads.name: Static HTML Streaming
workloads.description: Pure static HTML boilerplate streaming without dynamic variable interpolation, measuring raw buffer copying efficiency.

workloads.name: Scalar Variables
workloads.description: Evaluation of flat scalar variables (strings, integers, booleans) measuring lexical variable lookup and primitive formatting.

workloads.name: Deep Property Chains
workloads.description: Deeply nested bean/record access (order.customer.address.city.name) testing getter dispatch and reflection overhead.

workloads.name: Conditionals & Branching
workloads.description: Complex boolean conditionals, truthiness checks, and multi-branch alternatives testing branch evaluation speed.

workloads.name: Small Table Foreach Loop
workloads.description: Standard web table rendering (5 items x 3 columns) measuring loop frame allocation and row iteration efficiency.

workloads.name: Large Table Foreach Loop
workloads.description: High-volume batch rendering (100 items x 3 columns) measuring streaming allocation rate and memory stability.

workloads.name: Nested Foreach Loops
workloads.description: Hierarchical parent-child collection rendering measuring nested activation frame management and parent context navigation.

workloads.name: HTML Contextual Escaping
workloads.description: Streaming HTML escaping of unsafe characters (&, <, >, ", ') measuring escaper lookup, buffering, and encoding throughput.

workloads.name: Static HTML (20 KB)
workloads.description: 20 KB static HTML chunk rendering measuring zero-allocation literal write speed.

workloads.name: Scalar Substitutions (50 scalars)
workloads.description: Template binding 50 variables of mixed types measuring array slot access vs dynamic lookup.

workloads.name: Deep Property Chain
workloads.description: Depth 4-5 domain records measuring inline getter dispatch vs dynamic call site invocation.

workloads.name: Mixed Conditionals (100 branches)
workloads.description: 100 conditionals exercising boolean logic, null checks, and numeric truthiness.

workloads.name: Small Table Loop (10 rows x 5 cols)
workloads.description: Standard web table rendering measuring minimal per-row frame allocation.

workloads.name: Large Table Loop (1,000 rows x 5 cols)
workloads.description: High-volume batch rendering measuring maximum streaming throughput and zero GC pause operation.

workloads.name: Nested Loops (100 x 10)
workloads.description: Hierarchical structures with $foreach.parent navigation measuring scope stack efficiency.

workloads.name: Heavy Escaping
workloads.description: High density of unsafe characters measuring zero-allocation streaming HTML escaper performance.

workloads.name: Monomorphic Property Access
workloads.description: Single receiver type at dynamic call site measuring exact class guard branch overhead.

workloads.name: Polymorphic PIC Access (4 types)
workloads.description: Dynamic call site invoked with 4 distinct receiver shapes measuring AccessLink linear scan.

workloads.name: Macro-Heavy Rendering
workloads.description: Repeated calls to nested local and global macros testing macro parameter binding and frame reuse.

workloads.name: Two-Stage Layout Rendering
workloads.description: Screen and layout two-pass rendering evaluating screen_content capture buffer efficiency.

workloads.name: Large Report Streaming (1-5 MiB)
workloads.description: Multi-megabyte streaming text generation to OutputStream testing buffer flush and heap stability.

workloads.name: Missing / Denied Property Failure
workloads.description: Strict mode errors and security policy denial paths verifying clean diagnostic assembly without memory leaks.

workloads.name: Compile & Invalidate 1,000 Templates
workloads.description: Rapid template compilation and reverse-indexed invalidation under concurrency.
